identity.name: E1: The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a 'Gilded Vault' aesthetic that fuses Swiss Finance precision with High Fashion luxury. Avoid generic SaaS templates.

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-8 or p-12 for containers. p-4 is too tight.

grid_strategy.dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B: Dense, data-heavy, gap-4
grid_strategy.marketing: Tetris Grid Mode A: Asymmetric, gap-12, large hero spans

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300

cards.luxury: bg-card border border-gold-solid/20 shadow-lg hover:shadow-gold-solid/10 transition-all duration-500

inputs.default: h-12 bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:border-transparent transition-all

hero_product.alt: Grand gold necklace on white stand

traditional_collection.alt: South India Gold Jewellery on red velvet

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use generic gradients. Use noise/grain textures.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Playfair Display'.
DO NOT center everything. Use asymmetry.
DO NOT use default Shadcn cards without customization. Add hover effects.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Install fonts: Manrope and Playfair Display via Google Fonts in index.css.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Update tailwind.config.js with the 'Gilded Vault' color palette and font families.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Create a 'Layout' component that handles the Sidebar/Header structure for the Admin Portal.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement the 'Page Editor' using a drag-and-drop library (dnd-kit or react-dnd) with a dot-grid background.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the 'Subscription Plan' cards using the 'luxury' card style defined in components.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Ensure all forms (Login, Register, Product Add) use Shadcn Form + Zod validation.
